WHAT THE MONEY BUYS

XERJ Query-1 is a neurosymbolic model that compiles a question into a short program the engine runs over facts you have written, and shows the steps for lookups and comparisons. It was trained in FP16 on GPUs rented by the hour on Clore.ai, chosen by measured throughput per dollar, plus a few machines of our own. So far that cost thousands of dollars, not millions, paid for by donations; we have not published the exact amount yet.

The next training program is our estimate, not a measured number: about 100,000 H100 GPU-hours. It buys larger training worlds, robustness to fresh question wordings, sums and thresholds in the program vocabulary, fewer declined questions, and re-scoring on sealed evaluation sets. We publish our scores, including the ones we withdraw. The run records, evaluation data and scripts behind them are not public yet.

HELP WITHOUT MONEY
00 · TRY IT Run rc.101 with the model

Install the engine, add the model bundle, ask it questions over your own facts. The trace is the product.

xerj --facts-model-dir <DIR> 01 · REPORT File what breaks

A wrong answer, a confusing doc, an install that stalls: open a GitHub issue with the request and the response.

The engine is Apache-2.0. Fixes, docs and benchmarks land through ordinary pull requests.
